title: 第4章 二世祖、三世祖
content_zh:
（新书艰难，呼唤我的兄弟姐妹归来！风凌需要你们的帮助和支持！）

突然一个声音冷峭的道：“错！你不是二世祖！我才是二世祖，而你，是三世祖！”

君邪眼前，出现了一张轮椅，上面，一个三十多岁的瘦削的中年人斜斜倚坐在上面，两条腿上，盖着一条厚厚的缎子，一双似浑浊、似清明的眼睛，正玩味的看着他，双眉如剑，斜飞入鬓，自然而然地带有一种莫名的冷厉和杀伐之气！眼如鹰隼，厉光闪烁，目光深处，尚有着隐隐的鄙夷，虽然不多，却十分明显！

这人如不残疾，必是一位玉树临风的伟丈夫！铁骨凛凛的真豪杰！只从眉宇之中残留的威势看来，必然曾经是一位杀伐果决、号令千军万马的大将军！

“三叔？”君邪停住了脚步。看着这位端坐在轮椅上的三叔君无意，在君莫邪原本的记忆之中，这个三叔就是一个坐在轮椅上什么都不能做、混吃等死的废人，全无半点用处；但此刻的君邪却敏感的从这位常年坐轮椅的三叔身上，感到了一股熟悉的气息，这股气息，让人毛骨悚然！

唯有常年身经百战，从尸山血海之中拼杀出来的铁血军人，才会具有这等独特的锋锐！就像一把纵然断折也绝不会被尘土埋藏了他的锋芒的绝世利剑，散发着咄咄逼人的光芒！

惟这把绝世利剑，此时却藏于鞘里！

纵观君邪一生，如此等人物，至多也只见过两三人而已，而任何一人都是手握重军的大人物，事实上，这样的铁血悍将，却是君邪前世最欣赏的人物！其实君老爷子也是这一流的人物，只是老爷子随着年岁的渐长，自身修养已近反朴归真的境地，处处深藏不露，君邪又与老爷子相处甚暂，一时忽略！

但君无意却还没到这等韬光养晦的地步，整个人如锐剑在匣，锋芒虽藏却尤有凛然剑气外泄，当然，也需要有君邪的眼力才可以分辨，等闲人，如君莫邪之流，打死他也是分辨不到的！

绝世宝剑虽然闲置匣中，空悬墙上，但寂寂深夜犹作龙吟低啸！这是一种骨子里的嗜血！

“难得你还叫我一声三叔。”君无意抬起头，深邃的眼珠有些讥诮的看着自己这位唯一的侄儿：“莫邪，你很有兴趣想做二世祖吗？”说完突然叹了口气，暗道今天自己这是怎么了，怎么会对这样一滩扶不上墙的烂泥有了说话的兴致？

君邪看了他半天，却是着重在看他残疾的腰腿，突然笑了起来：“三叔说笑了，您才是货真价实的二世祖，我充其量也只是三世祖吧。侄子做个平安喜乐的三世祖就已经很满足了。”

恩？这小子今天怎么这种口气说话？虽然话中有刺，但却完全没有了往日的骄横跋扈？

对君邪答话大出意料的君无意眼睛一睁，霎那间眼中闪出一道锐利的光芒，就像是一缕夺目的闪电突然划破了阴霾的夜空！突然哈哈大笑，边笑边摇头，道：“你可知道，二世祖和三世祖的区别？”

“哦？还不一样都是混吃等死？有分别吗？！”君邪挑了挑眉毛，话中有刺。看到君无意目中电闪雷轰般的目光一闪，君邪倍觉如此铁血男儿，如此消沉下去，实在是尘世的一大遗憾！

君无意眼中闪过一道苦涩和不甘，旋即隐没了下去，干洁的右手抚在自己残腿上；抬头道：“此言大谬，如何没有分别，个中分别几近天差地远！二世祖，乃是父辈打好了天下，子辈坐享其成即可，完全没有什么难度，只要有一张嘴会吃，就一定死不了，而且最少也能够安享一生的荣华富贵！然而所谓的三世祖却不然，”

他看着君邪的眼睛，嘿嘿笑了笑，还击道：“所谓的三世祖，却并不一定特指第三代人，乃是第三世的传人；也就是说，爷爷辈的打下了天下，而中间父辈却出现了断层，这才叫三世祖！若你父亲还健在，那么你和我，都应该是二世祖，只不过我是从你爷爷这一辈算起，而你，是从你父亲这一辈算起。这里有所不同罢了。”

“但你爷爷如今已经老了，所以你就算有心做一个三世祖，只怕也做不了多长时间了；而你上面，除了你爷爷，已经再没有了别的大树可以乘凉，所以，你这个三世祖，之后的人生只怕会是非常艰难的！想要做一个合格的三世祖，如果没有几分本事和心机，是万万不成的。所以，我这个二世祖，比你这个三世祖要幸运一些。”

君无意说着，本来是为了还击君邪的那句‘混吃等死’，但说到后来，心中却不由得升起悲凉之意，偌大的君家，难道就这么完了吗？曾经鼎盛一时，一家之威令各国不敢正目视之的君家，眼下竟已到了这般地步吗！大哥二哥先后战死沙场，自己残疾；唯一有点盼头的两个侄儿，也同样战死沙场，尸骨无存；君家血脉，就只剩下了这一个草包废物一般的君莫邪！

突然间，君无意兴致全无，顿觉百无聊赖，连话也不想说了。

君邪沉默着，突然展颜笑道：“其实我也可以做二世祖的。”君无意的话，君邪何尝不懂，他之所以要君无意说出这番话，主旨却在于他以下的说辞！

君无意咳了两声，饶有兴趣却又有些懒洋洋的问道：“哦？”

“若三叔你为我做大树，撑起一片阴凉，我不就依然可以做二世祖吗？”君邪笑吟吟的道。

君无意眼中闪过一丝怒色，低沉的道：“莫邪，你又在嘲讽你三叔么？”

君邪打量着他，突然道：“腿上可尚有知觉吗？”

“无！”君无意把头扭过了一边，心中对这侄儿越来越是讨厌，明知道自己最忌讳别人提及自己的残废，却再三提及，之前总算还是隐晦说到，现在竟当面直问。如此不懂得尊敬长辈的后人，当真有不如无！

“无！”君无意大怒：“混账东西，若是腰骨碎了，我还能活到今日吗？！”

“也就是说，三叔你顶多只是经脉受损？是被人下了阴手？”君邪眼神一亮，看来是经脉被人截断或者是用阴毒的功夫侵蚀，致令萎缩了，若真是这样的话，只要气血未亏，倒还有几分希望，以自己的医道，应该还有机会救治。再怎么说也是这一世的血脉近亲，而打动君邪的，却是那一份铁血男儿的峥嵘锋锐！

君邪觉得，既然自己有能力，这样的一个铁血男儿，自己就应该让他站起来！不管他是不是自己的三叔！

君邪看着他，慢慢的道：“我听说你是在战场上受的伤，可在战场上下这样的阴手完全比直接杀了你要困难得多，为什么会这样？是不是你以往的宿敌故意要整你，才将你变成这么不死不活的样子？！”

一句话被捅到了痛处，君无意牙关一咬，额头青筋暴跳了几下，呼哧呼哧的大喘了几口气，才勉强控制住激动，冷声道：“这关你什么事？”

知道自己猜对了，君邪得意的一笑，伸手扶住轮椅，凑过头去，神秘的道：“三叔想不想报仇？”

“我这副样子，还谈什么报仇？”君无意瘦削的脸上显出一丝潮红，目中神色变幻，恨极的光芒一透而出；良久，才颓然一叹，道：“如今的我只是个废人罢了！”

君邪笑了笑，轻轻的道：“若是我有本事能够令三叔你重新站起来呢？”

(The new book is difficult, calling my brothers and sisters back! Fengling needs your help and support!)

Suddenly a cold voice said: "Wrong! You are not the second generation ancestor! I am the second generation ancestor, and you are the third generation ancestor!"

In front of Jun Xie's eyes, a wheelchair appeared. On it, a thin middle-aged man in his thirties was leaning on it. His legs were covered with a thick piece of satin. His eyes, which seemed to be cloudy and clear, were looking at him playfully. His eyebrows were like swords, flying sideways into his temples. Naturally, he had an inexplicable coldness and murderous aura!His eyes were like hawks, shining brightly, and deep in his eyes, there was still a hint of contempt. Although it was not much, it was very obvious!

If this man were not disabled, he would be a great husband!A true hero with strong bones!Judging from the remaining power in his eyebrows, he must have been a general who was decisive in killing and commanding thousands of troops!

"Third uncle?" Jun Xie stopped.Looking at the third uncle Jun Wuyi who was sitting in the wheelchair, in Jun Moxie's original memory, this third uncle was a useless person sitting in a wheelchair who could not do anything, was eating and waiting to die, and was completely useless. But at this moment, Jun Xie was sensitive and felt a familiar aura from this third uncle who had been sitting in a wheelchair all year round. This aura made people's hair stand on end!

Only iron-blooded soldiers who have experienced hundreds of battles all year round and fought their way out of mountains of corpses and seas of blood can possess such unique sharpness!Just like a peerless sword that will never be buried in the dust even if it breaks, it exudes an aggressive light!

But this peerless sword is now hidden in its sheath!

Throughout Jun Xie's life, he had only seen two or three such figures at most, and any one of them was a big shot with a heavy army. In fact, such a fierce warrior was the figure Jun Xie admired most in his previous life!In fact, Mr. Jun is also a first-class person, but as he grows older, his self-cultivation has reached a state of return to simplicity, and he hides everything. Jun Xie gets along with the old man for a long time, and ignores it for a while!

But Jun Xie has not yet reached the point of hiding his power and biding his time. His whole body is like a sharp sword in its box. Although the sharp edge is hidden, the sword energy leaks out. Of course, it also requires Jun Xie's eyesight to be able to tell the difference. Others, like Jun Moxie, can't tell the difference even if they beat him to death!

Although the peerless sword is idle in its box and hanging on the wall, it still roars like a dragon in the middle of the night!This is a kind of bloodthirsty in the bones!

"It's rare that you call me third uncle." Jun Wuyi raised his head and looked at his only nephew with his deep eyes mockingly: "Mo Xie, are you very interested in becoming the second generation ancestor?" After saying that, he suddenly sighed and thought to himself what had happened to him today, how could he be interested in talking to such a puddle of mud that couldn't hold up the wall?

Jun Xie looked at him for a long time, but focused on his disabled waist and legs, and suddenly laughed: "Third uncle is joking, you are the real second generation ancestor, and I am only the third generation ancestor at best. My nephew is satisfied with being a safe and happy third generation ancestor."

Huh?Why is this guy talking like this today?Although there is a thorn in the words, it is completely gone from the arrogance and domineeringness of the past?

Jun Xie's answer was completely unexpected. Jun Wuyi opened his eyes, and a sharp light suddenly flashed in his eyes, like a dazzling lightning suddenly piercing the hazy night sky!Suddenly he burst into laughter, shook his head while laughing, and said, "Do you know the difference between the second generation ancestor and the third generation ancestor?"

"Oh? Isn't it the same as just eating and waiting to die? Is there any difference?!" Jun Xie raised his eyebrows, and there was a hint of thorn in his words.Seeing the lightning-like flash in Jun Xie's eyes, Jun Xie felt that it was a great regret in the world for such a hard-blooded man to remain so depressed!

A trace of bitterness and reluctance flashed in Jun Wuyi's eyes, which disappeared immediately. He put his clean right hand on his stump and raised his head and said, "This is ridiculous. How can there be no difference? The differences are almost astonishing! The second generation ancestor is the father who has conquered the world. The children can just sit back and enjoy the success. It is not difficult at all. As long as you have a mouth that can eat, you will definitely not die, and at least you can enjoy a lifetime of glory and wealth! But the so-called third generation ancestor is not like that."

He looked into Jun Xie's eyes, smiled, and retorted: "The so-called third-generation ancestors do not necessarily refer to the third generation, but the descendants of the third generation; that is to say, the grandfather's generation has conquered the world, but there is a gap in the middle generation. This is called the third-generation ancestor! If your father is still alive, then you and I should be second-generation ancestors, but I count from your grandfather's generation, and you count from your father's generation. There is a difference here."

"But your grandfather is old now, so even if you want to be a third-generation ancestor, I'm afraid you won't be able to do it for long. And besides your grandfather, there are no other big trees above you to enjoy the shade. Therefore, you, the third-generation ancestor, will probably have a very difficult life in the future! If you want to be a qualified third-generation ancestor, you will never succeed without some ability and scheming. Therefore, I, the second-generation ancestor, are luckier than you, the third-generation ancestor."

Jun Wuyi said, originally to retaliate against Jun Xie's words of "eating and waiting to die", but after saying it, he couldn't help but feel sad in his heart. Is this the end of the huge Jun family?The Jun family, which was once so prosperous and so powerful that other countries dared not look at it, has now reached such a state!The eldest brother and the second brother died in the battlefield one after another, and he himself became disabled; the two nephews, the only ones who had any hope, also died in the battlefield, with no bones left; the Jun family bloodline is the only one left who is like a trash-like Jun Moye!

Suddenly, Jun Wuyi lost all interest, felt completely bored, and didn't even want to say anything.

Jun Xie was silent, then suddenly smiled and said: "Actually, I can also be the second generation ancestor." Jun Xie didn't understand what Jun Wu Yi said. The reason why he wanted Jun Wu Yi to say these words was because of what he said below!

Jun Yiyi coughed twice, and asked with interest but lazily, "Oh?"

"If Third Uncle you build a big tree for me and provide a shade, can't I still be the second generation ancestor?" Jun Xie said with a smile.

A flash of anger flashed in Jun Wuyi's eyes, and he said in a low voice: "Mo Xie, are you mocking your third uncle again?"

Jun Xie looked at him and suddenly said: "Do you still have feeling in your legs?"

"Nothing!" Jun Yiyi turned his head to the side, feeling more and more disgusted with his nephew in his heart. He knew that he was most afraid of others mentioning his disability, but he mentioned it again and again. He finally mentioned it in a vague way before, but now he asked him directly in person.Descendants who do not know how to respect their elders are really worse than nothing!

"Nothing!" Jun Wuyi was furious: "You bastard, if my waist bone was broken, would I still be alive today?!"

"That is to say, Third Uncle, your meridians were only damaged at most? Did someone trick you?" Jun Xie's eyes lit up. It seems that the meridians were cut off or corroded by sinister techniques, causing them to shrink. If this is the case, as long as the energy and blood are not lost, there is still some hope. With his own medical skills, there should be a chance to save him.After all, they were close blood relatives in this life, but what impressed Jun Xie was the sharpness of the iron-blooded man!

Jun Xie felt that since he had the ability, he should let such an iron-blooded man stand up!No matter if he is his third uncle or not!

Jun Xie looked at him and said slowly: "I heard that you were injured on the battlefield, but it is much more difficult to do something like this on the battlefield than to kill you directly. Why is this happening? Is it because your old enemies in the past deliberately wanted to punish you and turned you into such a stubborn person?!"

The words hit a painful spot. Jun Wuyi gritted his teeth, and the veins on his forehead jumped a few times. He gasped for breath for a few times, and then he managed to control his excitement and said in a cold voice: "What does this have to do with you?"

Knowing that he had guessed correctly, Jun Xie smiled proudly, stretched out his hand to support the wheelchair, leaned over and said mysteriously: "Third uncle, do you want to take revenge?"

"How can I talk about revenge when I look like this?" Jun Wuyi's thin face showed a trace of flushing, and the look in his eyes changed, and the light of hatred came out; after a long time, he sighed dejectedly and said: "Now I am just a useless person!"

Jun Xie smiled and said softly: "What if I have the ability to make you, Third Uncle, stand up again?"
